name: Generate Index Pages
description: Generates index pages for documentation collections. Creates navigable index.md files with links to all documents in each collection, organized by category and sorted by relevant metrics.

inputs.name: Collections
inputs.description: List of collections to index. If empty, indexes all collections.

inputs.name: Output Directory
inputs.description: Base directory for generated index files

inputs.name: Include Statistics
inputs.description: Whether to include aggregate statistics in index pages

outputs.name: Generated Indexes
outputs.description: List of paths to generated index files

outputs.name: Success
outputs.description: Whether all index files were successfully generated

metadata.author: Maestro Team
metadata.overrideInstructions: Clone this block to customize index templates, modify sorting options, or add custom grouping logic.
